name: ruby
title: Ruby
description: Furigana: small readings over (or under, or beside in vertical text) the characters they read, in native <ruby> / <rt> markup with <rp> fallbacks so the text copies, wraps and reads aloud. One reading over a whole word (base + reading) or one per character (parts). reveal="hover" hides the readings for learners until the word is hovered or focused, keeping their room so nothing reflows; the word is then focusable with a dotted underline that thickens on hover and the ink focus ring. CSS only, no JavaScript.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/ruby". The kit's fonts do not cover kanji: Japanese text falls back to the system's Japanese face (or add one of your own, such as Noto Sans JP, to --font-manga-body).

props.name: reading
props.description: The reading over the whole base.

props.name: parts
props.description: One reading per character or group (mono ruby). Takes over base and reading.

props.name: position
props.description: Side of the reading. In vertical text, over is on the right.

props.name: reveal
props.description: hover: readings show on hover or focus (room kept). never: hidden but still read aloud.
